title: Trade Validator
subtitle: Check if your trade aligns with your strategy rules
noStrategiesDesc: Create a strategy first to validate your trades against your rules.
howToUseDesc: After taking a trade, answer each rule honestly. Subjective rules (purple) require your honest self-assessment. Objective rules (amber/cyan) should match your actual trade parameters. Click "Validate Trade" to see if you followed your strategy.
alignedDesc: All {{count}} rules passed. This trade aligns with your strategy.
alignedReflection: You followed your trading plan. Whether this trade wins or loses, you made a disciplined decision. That's what separates professionals from gamblers.
notAlignedReflection: You deviated from your own rules. Before your next trade, ask yourself: Was this a conscious exception with valid reasoning, or was it emotional trading? Write down what triggered the deviation.
noRulesDefinedDesc: This strategy has no rules to validate against.
